sources.title: ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Model Summary: Granite-4.0-H-Micro is a 3B parameter long-context instruct model finetuned from Granite-4.0-H-Micro-Base using a combination of open source instruction datasets with permissive license and internally collected synthetic datasets.
